questions.prompt: How often do these things happen in your mathematics lessons? (Please select one response in each row.)

rows.label: Students do not listen to what the teacher said.
The teacher has to wait a long time for students to quiet down.
Students do not start working for a long time after the lesson begins.
Students get distracted by using digital devices or resources (e.g. smartphones, websites, apps).
Students get distracted by other students who are using digital devices or resources (e.g. smartphones, websites, apps).
